findings.deduction: V2 checks nonempty axes before its once-only phase, so repeated committed/partial calls reach INVALID rather than declared ALREADY_ENTERED. No second target call occurs, but the expected status is wrong.
findings.change: Recognize valid ENTERED/RAW_EXIT_PREPARED phase before empty-axis checks; preserve existing no-second-dispatch CAS.

findings.deduction: V2 begin does not revalidate initializer metadata: unknown flags, absent handle/buffer metadata and cleared close-reservation flags can reach a fake target after a trusted test corrupts a fresh cell.
findings.change: One common metadata_valid guard for initialization and fresh invocation. It is a structural guard only, not authentication of caller-owned bits.

findings.deduction: V2 typed query wrappers use fixed8/8202/36/592-byte output frames without checking that the reserved buffer metadata has a present id/generation and sufficient capacity.
findings.change: Validate fixed per-API frame-capacity metadata before dispatch in initializer and begin. Actual pointer bounds/lifetimes still require the absent genuine ticket bridge.

provenance: Root source deductions while comparing the independent authored79-case oracle with V2. No C build or execution observed; expectations are retained. Independent static review of V3 remains required.
unchanged: Header/layout,14 typed wrapper bodies, direct scalar stores, publish/finish and phase meanings unchanged; originalV1/V2 and their reviews retained.
